Vehicle Strikes Pedestrians in Los Angeles, Killing Three

A vehicle struck multiple pedestrians and street vendors near a Los Angeles metro station, resulting in three fatalities and several critical injuries. The driver of the vehicle, identified as a white SUV, has been arrested on three murder counts, according to police. The incident occurred next to a metro station in North Hollywood.
